text: In N=64 data_seed 1 seeds 22-23, force moves its best layer from 4 to 1 by step 1000 and stays at layer 1 through step 6000. In seeds 20-21 the move happened late (steps 2500-5000). Does the step at which force moves to layer 1 predict the final trained force R2 (0.847-0.866 here vs 0.779-0.838 for seeds 20-21)?
